name: feed the noob like crazy [UPD]
desc:
The most perfect experience for feeding a noob! This is technically a food simulator.

🍕 Ever wanted to experiment with different variations of foods? Well, this is the perfect game for you!

🍟 Make sure to only feed the noob with delicious food! If you don't, he probably won't like it & he will go bananas!

- If you purchase products/gamepasses, and don't get anything directly. Consider rejoining.
👍 Leave a like for updates! We have much planned👀
